title: Produce toggle component audit sheet
description: Audit the toggle filter as an individual binary component with explicit on/off semantics, track/thumb anatomy, and styling contracts.
objective: Define toggle behavior and styling without treating it as a checkbox clone.
acceptance_criteria: Switch track, thumb, label, checked state, disabled state, focus, hover, and layout modes are treated as separate subelements.
On/off semantics and accessibility expectations are explicit.
The audit does not implement toggle fixes yet.
verification: No plugin source changes are made.

budgets.context_budget: toggle render, option parser, option CSS, frontend JS

risks: Toggle can become visually charming but semantically ambiguous.
Track/thumb controls can bloat the Style panel without a clear anatomy.
